ANDAMAN & NICOBAR STATE CO-OP. BANK LTD.
HqAD-ATEIcE SBI VIJAYA PURAM
OUOTATION NOTICE
Ref No. : StCB/TC/MB llnterior 12026-27 17 7 Date: 05 I l0 12026
Sealed quotations are invited from experienced Contractors/Firm/ MSME Registered furniture shops dealing with furniture making
works for the Fabrication, Supply and lnstallation of Wooden Counters and other Wooden Office Furniture at A&N State
Cooperative Bank Ltd., Mayabunder Branch, in accordance with the drawings, specifications and scope of work provided by the
Bank on receipt of application for issue, duly supported by relevant documents like Copy of enlistment order/ MSME Registration,
PAN , GST Registration etc..
Completion Period: 60 (Sixty) days from the date of issue of Work Order.
Rate validity: The Quotations must remain open for acceptance for a period of 45(Forty Five) Days from the date of opening of Bid.
Terms & Conditions:
l. The quotation shall be submitted in a sealed cover along with an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten
Thousand only) in the form of Call Deposit ReceipVDemand DrafVBanker's Cheque/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) drawn
in favour of the Managing Director, A&N State Cooperative Bank Ltd., payable at Sri Vijaya Puram and shall be dropped in
the Quotation Box kept in the Office of the Undersigned on or before 2l/10/2026 upto 3:00PM. Bids received after the
prescribed date & time shall not be considered. The bids shall be opened on the same day on 2l/10/2026 at 3:30PM in the
I l.
presence of the Bidders/ their authorized representative who wish to remain present.
Quotations received without the prescribed EMD shall be summarily rejected.
The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all materials, labour, transportation, fitting, installation, taxes and all incidental charges
required for complete execution of the work,
The work shall be canied out strictly within the Bank premises during Bank working hours ensuring safety of both Staffs &
Customers and in accordance with the instructions of the Branch Manager and Technical Cell. The contractor shall ensure
that normal banking operations are not disrupted during execution of the work.
The EMD of the successful bidder sball be retained by the Bank until submission of the prescribed Performance Guarantee.
The successful bidder shall submit the Performance Guarantee within 07 (Seven) days from the date of issue of the Letter
of Acceptance (LOA). In the event of failure to submit the Performance Guarantee within the prescribed period, the EMD
ofthe successful bidder shall stand forfeited.
The successful bidder shall submit a Performance Guarantee equivalent to 5%o of the accepted contract value in the form
of Call Deposit Receipt /Demand Draft/Banker's Cheque/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) drawn in favour of the Managing
Director, A&N State Cooperative Bank Ltd., payable at Sri Vijaya Puram, valid for a period of 03 (Three) months. Upon
receipt of the Performance Guarantee, the Work Order will be issued. If the contractor fails to commence the work within 15
(Fifteen) days from the date of issue of the Work Order, the Performance Guarantee shall stand forfeited.
The Successful Bidder has to sign & execute the Formal Contract Agreement with the Bank within l0 (Ten) days from the
date of issue of Work Order. Upon Completion of all formalities including signing of Formal Contract Agreement, the EMD
shall be released.
A Security Deposit equivalent to l0o/o (Ten Percent) of the bill amount shall be deducted from the contractor's bill and
retained by the Bank for a Defect Liability Period of 12 (Twelve) months from the date of actual completion of the work.
The Performance Guarantee (PG) shall be released upon successful completion of the entire work.
During the Defect Liability Period, the contractor shall rectifl, at his own cost, any defect in materials, workmanship or
fittings within the time specified by the Bank. In the event of failure to carry out the rectification within the stipulated time,
the Bank shall be at liberty to get the rectification work executed through any other agency at the risk and cost of the
contractor, and the expenditure incurred shall be recovered from the Security Deposit.
The contractor shall complete the work within the stipulated period of 60 (Sixty) days. In the event of failure to complete
lhe work within the prescribed period, without extension of time approved by the Competent Authority on valid grounds, the
Bankshall havethelibertytoimposeCompensationforDelay,subjecttoamaximum ofl0%'(TenPercent)oftheaccepted
contract value, to be calculated @ 1.5% per month of delay to be computed on perday basis. The amount of compensation
so imposed shall be recovered from the contractor's bill, Security Deposit and/or Performance Guarantee, ai deemed
appropriate by the Bank, without prejudice to any other action deemed appropriate by the Bank.
The Bank reserves the right to accept or reject any or all quotations without assigning any reason whatsoever, and the decision
of the Bank shall be final and bindins on all bidders.
